frameworks.odd: Organic-Driven Development (Adaptive real-time telemetry and domain feedback)

architecture_layer: Dynamic Ensemble Training Pipeline (FastAPI PyTorch Service & Next.js React UI)
summary: Implementación desacoplada y tipada del selector individual de épocas por modelo en ensambles dinámicos (Dúo/Tríada). Resuelve la asimetría de convergencia entre redes livianas (EfficientNet-B0) y profundas (ResNet-34d) con retrocompatibilidad completa y observabilidad SVG desacoplada.

verified_endpoints.purpose: Launch ensemble training worker thread passing custom per-model epochs or falling back to preset/global epochs

odd_observability_features: Structured log emitted on each ensemble branch training worker start: [INFO] Iniciando entrenamiento de rama {idx}/{total}: {arch} ({epochs} épocas)
Adaptive pre-computation duration estimator in UI accurately sums individual model epochs when ensembleSize > 1
SVG Training Chart automatically calibrates horizontal intervals and epoch partitions according to each individual model's epoch budget

Individual model cards in Duo and Trio ensembles provide dedicated numeric input bounded to [1, 100] with architecture-aware presets (10 for EfficientNet, 12 for ConvNeXt, 15 for ResNet/PANNs, 20 for AudioCNN)
